summary: Copies a page by reading from the source and programming to the destination, handling XIP disable.
Returns the size of a flash partition in DEV_BSIZE blocks.
Closes a UART device by flushing output, closing the tty, and disabling the device.
Checks whether the UART receive FIFO is non-empty (ready to read).
Checks if the E15 guard window (800–998 µs) is active by comparing TIMERAWL to the last SOF.
Reads a character from the USB console by polling the RX ring and draining the buffer.
Opens a USB device, allocating a tty and configuring the endpoint.
Expands the packed text stream of an executable into a destination buffer for use by the swapper.
Zero-fills a memory region in the kernel address space.
Initializes the swap cursor position in flash, handling cold boot rejection and bounded random sampling.
